articles.summary: MURRAY, Utah, May 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FinWise Bancorp (NASDAQ: FINW) (“FinWise” or the “Company”), parent company of FinWise Bank (the “Bank”), today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a common stock repurchase program to purchase up to 685,000 shares, or approximately 5%
articles.title: FinWise Bancorp Announces Share Repurchase Program
